name: Gnomeregan
summary: In the poisoned halls of Gnomeregan, troggs and leper gnomes roam among broken defenses. Once the gnomes’ subterranean capital, it fell after a desperate defense turned to catastrophe.

sections.title: A Wonder of Engineering
sections.body: Gnomeregan’s halls once rang with the work of gnomish engineers. Built with aid from the Ironforge dwarves centuries ago, the city was carved into the snowy crags of western Dun Morogh. Steam-driven gears, copper piping, and vast assembly halls made it the heart of gnomish industry and invention. During the Second War, its designs, flying machines, and complex armaments supplied the Alliance. The city held firm even as Orgrim Doomhammer’s Horde laid siege.

sections.title: The Fall and the Poisoned Halls
sections.body: During the Third War, troggs surged from deep underground and broke into Gnomeregan’s lowest chambers. High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque chose to face the invasion alone, unwilling to draw Alliance armies away from the slaughter in Lordaeron. On the advice of chief engineer Mekgineer Thermaplugg, he ordered radioactive gas released through the lower chambers to wipe out the troggs. Instead, the gas empowered many of them and killed nearly eighty percent of the gnomish people. Those exposed who survived became twisted leper gnomes, and Thermaplugg took control of the poisoned ruins.

faq.q: Why is Gnomeregan full of radiation?
faq.answer: High Tinker Mekkatorque released radioactive gas into Gnomeregan’s lower vents as troggs overran the city, following Mekgineer Thermaplugg’s advice. The gas was meant to kill the troggs, but it slaughtered thousands of gnomes, mutated survivors into leper gnomes, and left the city permanently irradiated.

faq.q: Where are all the surviving gnomes now?
faq.answer: Surviving gnomes fled to Ironforge, where King Magni Bronzebeard gave them refuge in the Tinkers’ Court. High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque now works there to aid his scattered people and plan the return to their home.

aliases: who is the boss of gnomeregan
faq.answer: Mekgineer Thermaplugg controls Gnomeregan and has declared himself its king. Once Mekkatorque’s chief advisor, he now commands rogue defense automatons, irradiated leper gnomes, and mutant troggs from deep within the city’s core.

faq.q: Why didn't the Alliance help save Gnomeregan during the invasion?
faq.answer: Mekkatorque chose not to ask the Alliance for help. As the Scourge ravaged humanity during the Third War, the gnomes kept their struggle underground secret rather than draw vital defenders away from Lordaeron.

angles.text: For gnomes, Gnomeregan’s loss remains a deep wound. Entering its irradiated halls is a solemn pilgrimage to destroy Thermaplugg and recover lost mechanical heirlooms.
Even choked with radioactive poison, Gnomeregan holds the Eastern Kingdoms’ greatest concentration of schematics, advanced spare parts, and working industrial machinery.
